overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Board was scheduled to meet on October 12, 2026, to receive staff reports and consider new business including updates on DC Everest building plans and discussion of establishing an ethics committee and code of conduct. The meeting was set to take place at the Kronenwetter Municipal Center.

agenda.item: DC Everest Superintendent updated building plans
Discussion on reestablishing the ethics committee and a code of conduct

discussions.item: DC Everest Superintendent updated building plans
discussions.body: The board was scheduled to consider updates to building plans presented by the DC Everest Superintendent. This item was set for discussion and possible action during the new business portion of the meeting.

discussions.item: Discussion on reestablishing the ethics committee and a code of conduct
discussions.body: The board was scheduled to discuss the reestablishment of an ethics committee and the development of a code of conduct for the village. This item was set for discussion and possible action during the new business portion of the meeting.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled on the agenda, limited to 15 minutes total with a three-minute time period per person, at the discretion of the Chief Presiding Officer.
actionItems: Scheduled to consider DC Everest building plan updates
Expected to discuss reestablishing ethics committee and code of conduct
title: Village Board Meeting - 2026-10-12
